case_number: 2025 INSC 19; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO………………OF 2025 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 1093 of 2021)
summary: Challenge to rejection of quashing of chargesheet under IPC s.354, s.506; dispute between company directors over finances and management; allegations of sexual harassment and threat by R.K. Aneja, with appellant as co-director; preliminary inquiry found financial disputes but could not confirm harassment; CJM directed FIR registration under s.156(3) CrPC; FIR lodged against R.K. Aneja (A-1) and Naresh Aneja (A-2); co-petitioner's implication based on role as director and knowledge; issue of maintainability of prosecution in absence of specific allegations against appellant; question of whether dispute is primarily civil or criminal in nature.
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter remanded for reconsideration of quashing application with focus on specific role and allegations against appellant; proceedings not automatically liable to be quashed at threshold but narrow framing of charges examined.
